summary: Adds a paused state (active <-> paused, paused -> cancelled) to the subscription lifecycle; committed with a body explaining customers asked to pause instead of cancelling.

commit_message:
Let customers pause instead of cancelling

Customers asked for a way to pause billing rather than cancelling outright when they want a break; pausing keeps the subscription so resuming is instant.
